summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a 6-K reporting open-market treasury share purchases from 6-10 July 2026 under a buyback program approved 6 May 2026. It acquired 4,804,092 shares (0.16% of capital) at a weighted average price of €20.8156 per share, total consideration ~€100M. Since 8 May 2026, 34,495,587 shares (1.14%) repurchased for €759.9M, bringing total holdings to 4.01%. The program aims to provide additional shareholder remuneration beyond dividends. No board recommendation, advisors, premium, or timelines are disclosed. Watch for pace of remaining buyback authorization and impact on share count.
